zh-CN.title: 数字交锋，邀友推理
items: 新增七日数字交锋活动，空间管理员申领后即可开启，支持房间邀请和30秒同步对局
10／20／50分档随等级解锁，每日首场获胜双倍，失败不扣分

en.title: Challenge a friend to Code Duel
items: Space administrators can launch a seven-day Code Duel event with room invitations and simultaneous 30-second rounds
Unlock 10/20/50-point tiers by level, earn double for a first-match win, and never lose points
